summary: Supervisory evaluations, colleague endorsements, and verified professional references.

endorsements.author: Dr. Maria Elena Ramirez, Ed.D.
endorsements.text: Teacher Ramelito exemplifies the modern Philippine educator. His commitment to the Special Science Program has elevated our school's research reputation across the entire division. He transforms abstract biological models into tangible, community-oriented student investigations.

endorsements.author: Engr. Fernando Cruz, Ph.D.
endorsements.text: Jonmiru's mastery of constructivist pedagogy and his ability to author localized, decongested learning packages under the MATATAG curriculum makes him a premier asset and frequent benchmark demonstration teacher for our division.
